name: Google Drive backup
tagline: Save snapshots of conversations and settings to Google Drive.
notice: Reconnect when the access token expires. Disconnecting keeps local edits. Restoring merges conversations while retaining local API endpoints, keys and preferences.
privacy: Conversations are sent to Google. The drive.file scope limits access to app-authorized files. API keys and endpoints are excluded from backups.
snapshotsNotice: Each backup creates a new snapshot without overwriting earlier ones. Snapshots remain until you delete them in Drive.
